d: In a major setback for Tamil Nadu in the decades-old Cauvery water-sharing dispute, the Supreme Court on November 20, 2026, dismissed the state’s applications seeking over 11.719 TMC of additional water from Karnataka. A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh upheld Karnataka’s argument that backlogs cannot be cleared during a drought and water shortage. Reacting to the order, Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar stated the verdict reflects ground reality as the state lacks even drinking water, while DMK spokesperson T.K.S.
